content_sha256_method: sha256 of repr(column names) plus repr of 8000-row chunks fetched with select * ordered by the key. Timestamptz values were Python objects and required pytz.

synthetic.description: Deterministic fact_game and fact_player_game rows from a range index. Same columns as the published snapshot. Not the Lichess distribution.

strategy.microbatch_with_unique_key: microbatch incremental strategy does not support 'unique_key'. Microbatch runs delete+insert per batch based on 'event_time' and does not do key-based upserts. Remove 'unique_key' or use incremental_strategy='merge'.

scales.query_sql: select sum("eligible_score"), sum("score_eligible"), sum("eligible_win") from player_games
scales.query_connection: read_only, DuckDB default memory_limit, one connection reused for every repeat, so the samples are warm buffer-pool times. Same default memory as the analyst. Not an adoption metric.
